stuffing.source: Allen & Schiller, NASA/NOISE-CON2016, Experimental evaluation of equivalent-fluid models for melamine foam, Table1 and pp3–6. Soundfoam MLULb specimen, measured sigma9400Pa·s/m²; published eight-coefficient fit uses X=rho_air*f/sigma. https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20160010140

limitations: Material 1: material properties are treated as isotropic. Match the source measurement direction and packing; fibre orientation and compression can change them.
Material 1: retained material use band is 100–1000Hz; results outside that band are not validated by this preset.
Material 1: 1D wall lining uses an equal-pressure parallel-channel approximation. The 3D steady-tone solver places the liner at channel walls; refine cells across its thickness.

Material 1: source specimen parameters do not characterize an arbitrary purchased batch. Fit weighted below1kHz; approximate declared use band100–1000Hz from the study plots. Frame effects near1kHz are not modelled. Not a universal foam law.

materialSpectra.name: Hollow polyester · historical loose fill
materialSpectra.source: Martin J. King, 2003 damping correlation, Dacron Hollofil II; http://quarter-wave.com/TLs/Damping_Coefficient.pdf pp1–3. Interpolated speed and transfer to other batches remain assumptions.
materialSpectra.note: For the historical Hollofil correlation only. Density is adjustable within its retained calibration range; it is not a generic wool or foam model.

materialSpectra.name: Polyester batt · WM20 research sample

materialSpectra.name: Polyester batt · compressed WM20 sample
materialSpectra.source: Yang et al., doi:10.1177/0040517518811940, accepted manuscript Table2/PDF p8: WM20, thickness14.27mm, density35.56kg/m³, measured sigma14989±285Pa·s/m²; acoustic tests200–4200Hz. https://eprints.whiterose.ac.uk/id/eprint/142018/1/Accepted%20version.pdf
materialSpectra.note: Separate measured compressed specimen. Compression changes resistance; this is not a density scaling rule.

materialSpectra.name: Glass wool · Miki research example
